id.description: Stable unique identifier; do not reuse it for a different notice.

type.description: info and maintenance items use the inbox/archive. warning items are active notices, require startsAt and expiresAt, and have no read/archive state.

startsAt.description: Optional publication start time in ISO 8601 UTC. If omitted, the notification is active immediately.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration time in ISO 8601 UTC. If omitted, the notification remains active indefinitely; at or after this instant, clients must hide or remove it. When startsAt is present, expiresAt must be later.

title.description: Localized title. pt-BR is required; en is optional and falls back to pt-BR when absent.

message.description: Localized Markdown message. pt-BR is required; en is optional and falls back to pt-BR when absent.

url.description: Optional HTTPS destination for more information.

label.description: Localized call-to-action label. pt-BR is required; en is optional and falls back to pt-BR when absent.

url.description: Localized HTTPS call-to-action destination. pt-BR is required; en is optional and falls back to pt-BR when absent.

action.description: Optional localized call-to-action. Clients should use it before the legacy url field when present.

en.description: Optional English text; clients fall back to pt-BR when it is absent.
Optional English HTTPS destination; clients fall back to pt-BR when absent.
